counter_thesis: The NAV premium over price is a leverage illusion: ~1,011bn of the 2,231.6bn debt stack matures within a year, dividends already exceed consolidated attributable earnings (payout 152.6% filed), and if refinancing reprices at current rates the appraisal uplift belongs to lenders, not shareholders; carrying-value NAV (4,992/share) is the honest floor and it sits below the market price.

issues.description: the maturity wall (전단채 2026-04 rolled, 단기차입 2026-06, 사모사채·숭례 2026-09, ~1,011bn current portion) makes the equity a levered claim on cap rates; no scenario prices a failed roll
requested_evidence: refinancing terms from the 2026.09 half-year filing

issues.description: attributing the appraisal uplift to owners at the balance-sheet equity ratio 0.7782 is a simplification; the NCI sits in specific property vehicles and the true attributable uplift may differ per asset
